+def record(kind: str, request: dict, result) -> None:
+    item = {

+        "kind": kind,
+        "request": request,
+        "meta": result.meta,
+    }
+    with LOG.open("a") as f:

+    d = RUNS / f"{int(time.time() * 1000)}_{kind}"
+    result.save(str(d))
+    print(json.dumps({"saved": str(d), "done": result.meta.get("done"),
+                      "reason": result.meta.get("reason"),
+                      "time_left_s": result.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+                      "plan": result.meta.get("plan")}, indent=2))
+
+
+def observe(robot: Robot, label: str = "observation"):
+    result = robot.get_obs(video="none")
+    for cam, frame in result.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"{label}_{cam}.png")
+    record("observe", {"label": label}, result)
+    print("proprio:", json.dumps(result.meta.get("proprio", {})))
+    return result
+
+
+def ee(robot: Robot, xyz, quaternion=None, gripper=None, note=""):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")

+    if gripper is None:
+        gripper = float(now[15])
+    row = np.asarray([*xyz, *quaternion, gripper], dtype=np.float32)
+    result = robot.submit("ee_pose", row, note=note, video="both", video_fps=5)
+    record("ee_pose", {"pose": row.tolist(), "note": note}, result)
+    return result
+
+

+    obs = robot.get_obs(video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
